about.author_brandmeister: Special thanks to the authors, developers, and sponsors of BrandMeister — without them, this advanced ecosystem and great community would not exist
about.credits_title: Credits to Open-Source Authors and Amateur Platform Enthusiasts
about.desc_allstar: Global AllStarLink repeater and node network, IAX2 protocol, AllMonDB directory, and ASL3 / app_rpt server engine.
about.desc_auth: Thank you for the open and reliable tools for cryptographic password hashing, session security, and encrypted profile backups (.7z).
about.desc_brandmeister: Connection to BrandMeister DMR network via Homebrew Repeater protocol and REST API v2.
about.desc_crypto: Cryptographic security, automated SSL/TLS certificate generation, and secure WSS connections.
about.desc_dmr_networks: Open amateur radio networks TGIF, FreeDMR, ADN Systems, DMR+/IPSC2, XLX multiprotocol reflectors, and Pi-Star host directories.
about.desc_dmrutils: Python 3 library for DMR frame parsing, HomeBrew repeater protocol, and AMBE processing.
about.desc_dsdfme: Foundational open-source MBE speech synthesis library and digital radio vocoder decoding algorithms.
about.desc_fastapi: Asynchronous high-performance web framework and strict data validation for API endpoints and WebSocket gateway.
about.desc_ffmpeg: Universal multimedia framework for encoding, compression, and converting on-air radio recordings to MP3.
about.desc_gemini: Multimodal live radio speech recognition, context-aware neural QSO translation, and expressive cloud TTS.
about.desc_groq: Special thanks for the lightning-fast speech recognition speed and generous free limits that make AI transcription accessible to every radio amateur.
about.desc_llamacpp: Thank you for making smart neural translation run right on a standard CPU — lightweight, offline, and with great understanding of live conversational speech.
about.desc_mbelib: High-performance software AMBE+2 encoder and decoder featuring 256-point WOLA FFT synthesis (PFFFT) and packet loss concealment.
about.desc_mmdvm: HomeBrew Repeater and MMDVM protocol for connecting with BrandMeister, TGIF, FreeDMR, ADN Systems, DMR+, and XLX reflectors.
about.desc_numpy_scipy: High-performance scientific computing libraries powering server-side audio DSP, filtering, AGC, and spectral analysis.
about.desc_piper: Fast local neural text-to-speech engine (TTS) powered by ONNX Runtime for voice readout of radio traffic, callsigns, and talkgroups.
about.desc_radioid: Global DMR ID registration database and amateur radio callbooks providing operator photos, QTH locators, and coordinates.
about.desc_silero: Sincere thanks for the natural, expressive voices and fast local speech synthesis that make radio traffic sound alive without cloud latency.
about.desc_sqlite: Robust embedded relational database engine and async driver powering user accounts, settings, and logs.
about.desc_uvicorn: Lightning-fast ASGI web server implementation for async Python applications.
about.desc_webaudio: Browser low-latency DSP audio pipeline: AGC, 3-band parametric EQ, presence filter, and TS1/TS2 stereo routing.
about.desc_websockets: Open-source ASGI toolkit, WebSocket driver, and Jinja2 templating for real-time bidirectional PCM audio streaming and telemetry.
about.freesoft_sub: Free and open-source software for amateur radio operators

hs_edit.tgif_help_step3: On the «Static Tokens» tab, select or enter your hotspot (full ID including SSID, e.g. 250xxxx01).
hs_edit.tgif_help_step4: Generate a Static TG API Token for this device.
hs_edit.tgif_help_step5: Copy the generated token, paste it into the field above and save hotspot settings.

adn_help_title: Hotspot setup on ADN Systems Network:
adn_help_step1: Hotspot password: by default most ADN nodes accept passw0rd, or your personal security password from ADN SelfCare.
adn_help_step2: Static Groups (TS1 / TS2): configured in the RPTO string OR via visual manager by clicking «⚡ Manage TG» on hotspot card.
adn_help_step3: RPTO parameters: TIMER=10 (dynamic timeout in mins), SINGLE=1, VOICE=0 (disable beacon), PASS=... (SelfCare password if specified in options).
adn_help_step4: Reset dynamic TGs: call to TG 4000 or reset button in TG Manager.
adn_help_step5: Voice Beacon: parameter VOICE=0 disables periodic voice beacon of ADN server to avoid cluttering air and transcription.

hs_edit.dstar_help_1: Protocols: DCS (port 30002) for XLX and DCS reflectors, DExtra (port 30001) for XRF, DPlus (port 20001) for REF.
hs_edit.dstar_help_2: Callsigns & Modules: RPT1 is built from callsign and local module (8th position, default B). Reflector connects to chosen module (letter in 8th position).
hs_edit.dstar_help_3: Slow Data: text message up to 20 characters is sent synchronously with voice inside the D-STAR radio frame.
hs_edit.net_dstar: 🔵 D-STAR Network — XLX / DCS / DExtra / DPlus
hs_edit.svx_help_1: Registration & Key: SVXReflector networks are independent; connecting requires a callsign and an individual AUTH_KEY issued by the chosen reflector portal (e.g. fm-funknetz.de, svxportal.sm2ampr.net, portal.be.svx.link, rolink.network).
hs_edit.svx_help_2: Talk Groups (TG): transmission goes to the active TG (0 = listen-only / Standby). Additional TGs in the Monitor list are received in parallel.
hs_edit.svx_help_3: Protocol & Ports: TCP (control) + UDP (Opus) on the reflector port (typically 5300; FM-Funknetz uses 5308). Supports DNS SRV (_svxreflector._tcp) and automatic V2/V1 negotiation.
